name: topic_split_20ng
description: Oracle starts with an under-clustered view (k=3) on 20 Newsgroups and splits broad clusters into more focused topic groups. Tests split and rename operations on topic-based news data. Mirrors the sentiment_split scenario for cross-dataset comparison.

oracle_turns.raw_text: The largest cluster seems to mix computer-related posts with space and astronomy content — those are quite different topics. Split it into a 'Computer Graphics & Technology' cluster and a 'Space & Astronomy' cluster.
Another cluster appears to combine sports and automotive content. Split it into 'Sports' for baseball-related posts and 'Automotive' for car-related posts.
Rename the remaining cluster that covers health, medicine, and political topics to something more accurate — maybe 'Health & Politics'.
The clustering is now much more granular and useful. I'm satisfied with these groups.
